profile.headline: Computer Scientist | Test Software Engineer @ Universal Audio | Diagnostics, Drivers & Embedded in C/C++ | Applied AI/LLM | 25+ yrs | US Patent holder
profile.summary:
I make hardware work — and lately, I ship production AI.
Nearly thirty years on the first. The last few on the second. The interesting work is where they meet.
WHAT I DO WITH HARDWARE
I write the low-level software that makes physical devices run, and the test systems that catch defects before customers ever see them — across Windows, macOS, Linux, and bare metal.
• Test Software Engineer at Universal Audio for 14 years
• Firmware and drivers in C/C++ for professional audio hardware — DSPs, microcontrollers, PCIe, USB, and Thunderbolt
• Windows tooling in C#/.NET, including the device authorization application that I extended from manufacturing to Customer Service Repair, along with registration fixes that unblocked production
• A Python/Flask web application that gates our production line — automated build verification that walks operators through fixes when something fails
• Earlier work: audio hardware at Digidesign/Avid, industrial deposition systems at FUJIFILM Dimatix, and network diagnostics and drivers at 3Com
WHAT I DO WITH AI
I build tools that make dense engineering information readable — for engineers and everyone else. I also build with AI: Claude is part of my daily workflow for system design, coding, debugging, and documentation.
• Designed and shipped a serverless AI service as the sole developer using TypeScript, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and Amazon Bedrock — architected and implemented with Claude as my design partner
• It turns engineering change records into plain-English summaries that the entire company can understand
• Adding a new data source is a configuration change, not new code
• In production since mid-2026, built and maintained by one engineer
• Selected for Universal Audio's internal AI Guiding Coalition — delivered three company-wide presentations and designed an AI adoption program for a cross-functional team spanning mechanical engineering, QA, and procurement
ALSO WORTH KNOWING
• U.S. Patent 7,076,496 — Server-Based Software Product Release Version Tracking
• M.S. in Computer Science, San José State University — master's project on testing FPGA interconnect resources
• My first AI project was an expert system for gastroenterology, written in BASIC on a DEC PDP-11 in 1984. It's been a long road back.
Open to hard problems where hardware meets software: embedded systems, professional audio, hardware validation, AI tooling for engineers, FPGAs, and high-performance computing.

positions.title: Test Software Engineer
positions.description:
Diagnostics, drivers, firmware, and AI tooling for professional audio hardware.
• Build diagnostics and system bring-up tools for audio devices across PCIe, USB, FireWire/1394, and Thunderbolt — reducing hardware validation time and surfacing defects earlier in production. • Develop firmware for the ADSP-21469 DSP and embedded code for ATmega16PB/ATtiny88 microcontrollers. • Author cross-platform drivers and GUI applications for Windows (C/C++/.NET) and macOS (C/C++/Python). • Built a Linux/Flask web app for automated product build verification that catches 100% of production failures and guides operators with corrective-action feedback. • Designed and shipped a production, config-driven serverless framework (TypeScript on AWS Lambda) that uses generative AI to turn engineering change data into plain-English summaries — making previously engineer-only information accessible across the organization. • Integrated AI/LLM tooling into the dev workflow to accelerate code generation, debugging, analysis, and documentation. • Selected member of the company’s Internal AI Guiding Coalition; delivered 3 company-wide presentations on practical AI/LLM tooling.

positions.title: Director
positions.description:
Consulting and custom software development.
• Delivered consulting and custom software for general-purpose computing systems. • Built custom office-automation solutions that cut manual processes by 80%, improving efficiency, data accuracy, and productivity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software for precision materials-deposition hardware.
• Designed multilayered, multithreaded C/C++/.NET software controlling deposition hardware. • Developed device drivers, embedded applications, communication layers, and GUI tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Test and tooling software for professional audio hardware.
• Built functional test applications and multi-tier systems (drivers, application logic, GUIs in C/C++/.NET) for audio hardware — PCI/PCIe, DSPs, Intel CPUs, CAN, FireWire — used in production validation. • Partnered with hardware and firmware teams to improve product testability.

to keep students information such attendance, progress, job placement and follow up.
